text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, racing fans. It's almost time 
for the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown! In this race—

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
The legendary Narita Brian is running 
today! What kind of race will she show us?

The Twinkle Series is abuzz with chatter 
about Narita Brian entering the Satsuki 
Sho. Meanwhile, Biko Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Brian-san is definitely 
amazing... But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hype up the sprint division too! 
Everyone's waiting to see me shine!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's do our best! But don't push 
yourself too hard.

Yeah, let's do our best! But don't push 
yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pushing myself...? Oh, right. My leg just 
healed, after all... Yeah, I'll be 
careful!
Right at that moment—
(Knock knock—)

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Toh! Excuse me for intruding!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I came to cheer you on, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~~, big sis! You actually came!

The person inside Carrot Man, whom I met 
during the "Open Training," came over.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I guess I'm a bit late. Some stuff 
came up.... I'm sorry....”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine! A hero always arrives just 
in the nick of time, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of circumstances, though? Did 
your photoshoot run late or something?"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just a part-time gig. As for my 
main gig... I haven't had much luck 
passing auditions.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Action stars just don't have the same 
presence on screen if they're too small, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Miss...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! There's no reason to be 
discouraged over something like that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll show 'em! Even if I'm small, I 
can do it if I try!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Right, thank you! It sounds like the 
opponent is pretty strong, but I'm looking 
forward to it!

Biko Pegasus vows to give it her all, if 
only for the older girl's sake. However, 
defeating today's opponent will certainly 
be no easy feat.
Above all else, the greatest rival is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Biko! This won't be quite like 
the event-by-event competition, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not letting my guard down at all! As 
your proud rival, I'm taking my revenge!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, bring it on, Sis Hishiama! 
That's just what I've been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Last time was just a preview of the next 
episode! This New Zealand Trophy is the 
real deal!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose, Hishi Amazon! You're the 
strongest one out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Go, Biko Pegasus-! Show us another 
comeback!

With the emergence of an unprecedented 
powerhouse like Hishi Amazon, this year's 
Classic tier is buzzing with immense 
excitement, even outside the Triple Crown.

It was a chance to grab the spotlight for 
Biko Pegasus as well. Despite lingering 
concerns about her legs, her next 
challenge was about to begin.
